st: Peter Steinberger, retired at 40 after selling PSPDFKit (€100M, Insight Partners), releases OpenClaw: an open-source proto AI agent that taught itself to decode a voice recording.

sec.t: ff.144.1 OpenClaw and the PDF retiree
sec.p: Peter Steinberger was in Morocco when he accidentally sent a voice note to his Telegram bot: the bot, without being programmed for audio, decoded the message on its own using OpenAI's Whisper. Astonished, Steinberger released the code as open source under the name OpenClaw…

sec.t: ff.144.2 Lobsters in literature and AI
sec.p: In Accelerando (Charles Stross), KGB lobsters become digital minds and space explorers — a crustacean's brain is easier to map. Sartre (Nausea) and Lanthimos (The Lobster) complete the bestiary: the lobster as a symbol of marginalisation and transformation. David Foster…
